items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible growth; counsel_required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and future affiliate or advertising use. Exact decision: keep the gated product private and keep external outreach unsent. Evidence: source documentation establishes API access mechanics but not rights to store, transform, cache, display, retain historical derivatives, send alerts, use images, trademarks, prices, or monetize returned data; current public terms point against the proposed use. Fleet compliance is a technical baseline only: 35 pass, 14 fail, 10 unknown, with open banner, consent, analytics, privacy, and terms findings. Incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary reversible growth when existing consent, disclosure, data-handling, claims, provenance, and platform-policy boundaries are preserved.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed and 4 remain open. No task is closable because current artifacts are partial. Open tasks are source rights; alert-data flow and retention; GA4 consent/configuration; and logs, vendors, and incident handling. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Do not send outreach, change the private gate, enable tracking, expand alerts, or expand monetization.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data = counsel_required and launch-blocked; user alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed; GA4 analytics = evidence_needed; operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data = evidence_needed. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and any future affiliate or advertising use. The smallest next actions are respectively: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for counsel review; produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table; capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking; and produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory covering log fields, retention, access, incident, and data-request procedures.

Compliance and claim triage: preserve cookie and analytics disclosures, consent and withdrawal behavior, affiliate disclosures, claims substantiation, data provenance and rights, copyright and trademark boundaries, platform-policy limits, and regulated or age-sensitive safeguards where supported by site evidence. Do not infer adult or regulated status from domain names. Revenue evidence covers one dated window only: $4.92 aggregate commission is not site-attributable; no ROI, margin, payback, or monetization-expansion decision is supported. Continue only existing failure repair-or-close, measurement reconciliation, and bounded read-only legal/security evidence.
